description: Stormwater Control Ordinance (Article VI §345-74) 2020 is a dataset listed in Analyzejerseycity open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Analyzejerseycity. Review and discussion of Jersey City’s Stormwater Control Ordinance (Article VI §345-74), updated in accordance with N.J.A.C. 7:8 - Stormwater Management. Sponsored by City Planning staff. Formal action may be taken. Coverage: Jersey City, New Jersey. The portal files it under Housing & Properties. The portal shows 2020-11-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-jerseycitynj-gov-portal.
